sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: A Discogs release's image revision page (…/images/history?rev=N, "Previous State of Images") gets a button: "Show every image revision". Until now the script did not run on that page at all, so it had no button and no link previews. The button shows one sub-table per revision of the release's images, newest first. Each heading names the revision, when it was made, by whom and its note; the page's own revision says "this page". Each image has a Change column comparing it with the revision before (+ added, moved, → primary, → secondary), and an image the revision removed gets its own greyed row, "− removed". The Image column has the image card and the viewer, as on the Images page. The button reads the release's edit history (one request a page), then one request a revision, with your Discogs session. The page's own links now have link previews too, as on the other older Discogs pages.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The preview window of a Discogs release's image history (…/images/update, opened for example from a link on the release's edit history page): a hover on a thumbnail in its table now shows that image big with its type, uploader, date, size and file size, and a click opens the image viewer on the full image, where Shift+→ / Shift+← step through the rows. Before, the thumbnails had no card, and on MusicBrainz a click opened the image in a new tab instead of the viewer.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: A release's Images page and its image editor on discogs.com ("Show every image"): a hover on an image in the Image column now shows that image big with its type, uploader, date, size and file size, and a click opens the image viewer, where Shift+→ / Shift+← step through the rows in the order shown. Until now these tables had no hover card at all: the card looked for the row's release in a Title column, and these tables have none. The card asks Discogs for nothing (the row is the image); it is switched off with the setting for the Discogs Image column's hover card. A table saved to disk earlier gets the card too.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Links to an image revision of a Discogs release (…/images/history?rev=N, the "Images" links of image changes in a release's edit history, in the history's preview window and in the table of the edit history page) have their own preview window. Before, they showed the release itself. The window lists every revision that changed the release's images, newest first, with who changed them, when and the note, and highlights the revision the link points to. That revision shows its images and what changed since the revision before: + added, moved, → primary / → secondary, and removed images greyed out. A click on an image opens the image viewer. Every other revision shows its images when you press its "▸ Show images"; "Load the N other revisions" reads all of them, one request each (Stop ends it). To list every revision, the window reads every page of the release's edit history. A revision's images come from Discogs' image editor, so they are read with your Discogs session, as the Image history window already does; signed out, the revisions are still listed, each saying why its images are missing. Like the other Discogs history windows, it reads only when you press Space, never on a hover.
